Daly, H.E. and Fais, B. (2014). UK TIMES Model Overview. UCL Energy Institute, University College London, November 2014. 15 pp. No DOI or report number printed.

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A 15-page description of the UK TIMES Model (UKTM): heritage from UK MARKAL, the TIMES/VEDA toolchain, eight-sector structure (RSR, PRC, ELC; RES, SER, IND, TRA, AGR), base-year (2010) and SubRES template files with backing spreadsheets, calibration to DUKES 2011, emissions accounting, and research strands. It prints no technology costs, efficiencies, capacities or energy intensities and no price year. The only numbers: model discount rate 3.5% (HM Treasury Green Book), 16 time-slices (4 seasons x 4 intra-day periods), base year 2010 with 2011 and 2012 calibration periods, then 5-year periods to 2100; CHP plants are modelled in the end-use sectors they serve. Requested in to-get.csv as 'UKTM model documentation (UCL Energy Institute 2014)' to confirm the 2010 GBP price basis, capacity units, efficiency definitions and data sources behind the bataille_2017_001 UKTM sheet: this overview does not answer that; it points to the full documentation 'Daly, H.E., Dodds, P.E. and Fais, B. (forthcoming). The UK TIMES Model Documentation' (http://www.ucl.ac.uk/energy-models/models/uktm-ucl), which is still not held. It confirms only that base-year data are for 2010 (which supports, but does not state, a 2010 price basis).
